description: NextGen Connect / Mirth Connect HL7 channels as Dagster assets. One asset per declared channel; action=deploy deploys+starts the channel on materialize, confirmed by polling /channels/statuses (deploy/start return 204 unconditionally). Optional shared polling sensor turns cumulative message counters into per-tick deltas (AssetObservation); materialize_on_completion additionally emits a real AssetMaterialization once a channel drains, for downstream eager()-style gating. Optional channel_running, channel_drained, and channel_error_rate asset_checks. demo_mode runs the whole shape with synthetic data and zero real Mirth server.

outputs.description: One Dagster asset per declared Mirth Connect HL7 channel. With action=noop (default) each asset is declare-only (external asset). With action=deploy each materialization deploys + starts the channel via the Administrator REST API and polls /channels/statuses to confirm it actually reached STARTED. Optional polling_sensor emits AssetObservation per channel when its message counters move; optional require_running / error_rate_threshold checks per channel.

base_url_env_var.label: Base URL Env Var
base_url_env_var.description: Env var holding the Administrator REST API base URL, e.g. https://mirth-host:8443/api. The /api suffix is required.

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: Env var with the Mirth username (Basic auth).

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: Env var with the Mirth password (Basic auth).

verify_ssl.label: Verify SSL
verify_ssl.description: Mirth ships with a self-signed TLS certificate by default -- set false for lab/demo installs still using the stock cert.

channels.label: Channels
channels.description: HL7 channels to wrap as Dagster assets, one entry per channel (channel_id, asset_key, description, group_name, deps, owners, tags).

assets_by_channel.label: Assets By Channel
assets_by_channel.description: Override the asset spec for specific channels, keyed by channel_id. Mirrors the official dagster-databricks DatabricksWorkspaceComponent.assets_by_task_key shape.

action.label: Action
action.description: noop = external asset (declare-only); deploy = deploy + start the channel, confirmed by polling /channels/statuses (the channel must already be enabled in Mirth Administrator).

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for a channel to reach STARTED before failing the run. Only used when action=deploy.

polling_sensor.label: Polling Sensor
polling_sensor.description: If true, adds ONE sensor (not one per channel) that emits AssetObservation per channel when its cumulative message counters moved since the last tick.

check_interval_seconds.label: Check Interval (seconds)
check_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between sensor polls. Only used when polling_sensor=True.

materialize_on_completion.label: Materialize On Completion
materialize_on_completion.description: Requires polling_sensor=true. Also emits a real AssetMaterialization (tagged with a dagster/data_version) the first tick a channel has received new messages since its last materialization AND currently has nothing queued (drained). Deduplicated against the last materialized data_version. AutomationCondition.eager()-style gating only reacts reliably to AssetMaterialization, not AssetObservation.

require_running.label: Require Running
require_running.description: If true, attach a channel_running asset_check per channel that fails when the channel's dashboard state isn't STARTED.

require_drained.label: Require Drained
require_drained.description: If true, attach a channel_drained asset_check per channel that passes only when the channel currently has nothing queued (queued == 0) -- a readiness gate a downstream job/sweep can require before starting.

error_rate_threshold.label: Error Rate Threshold
error_rate_threshold.description: If set, attach a channel_error_rate asset_check per channel that fails when error / max(received, 1) exceeds this fraction (lifetime cumulative, not windowed).

group_name.label: Group Name
group_name.description: Dagster asset group for channels without their own group_name.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Catalog tags applied to every channel asset (merged with each channel's own tags).

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Default asset owners for channels without their own.

demo_mode.label: Demo Mode
demo_mode.description: Skip the real Mirth server entirely. Deploy/start/stop, statuses, and statistics all return synthetic values instead of calling the REST API.

name: Mirth Connect Workspace
